meaning:
band, bond, imprisonment
Aramaic of e.sur (אֵסוּר "bond" H0612)

elsewhere.note: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment…
Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew…
